data.name: CellType_Description
data.value: HTTP request cell type for sending REST API requests.
data.comment: What an HTTP cell is, shown when choosing a cell type.

data.name: CellType_Name
data.comment: Name of the HTTP cell type, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Completion_Header_Accept

data.comment: What the Accept header is for, offered while typing and shown on hover. The header name at the start is part of the standard and stays as written.

data.name: Diagnostic_MissingUrl
data.comment: Marked against a request line with a method and nothing after it.

data.name: Diagnostic_NoRequest
data.value: No valid HTTP request found. Start with a method (GET, POST, etc.) followed by a URL.
data.comment: Marked against a cell that holds text but no request. The method names stay as written.

data.name: Kernel_Description
data.value: Executes HTTP requests using .http file syntax.
data.comment: What the HTTP kernel is, shown wherever kernels are listed. .http is a file extension and stays as written.

data.name: Kernel_Name
data.comment: Name of the HTTP kernel, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Magic_SetBase_Description
data.value: Sets the base URL for relative HTTP request URLs.
data.comment: What #!http-set-base does, shown in the list of magic commands.

data.name: Magic_SetBase_Done
data.comment: {0} is the address that was set.

data.name: Magic_SetBase_Name
data.comment: Name of the #!http-set-base magic command as an extension, as listed in the Extensions panel. The command word itself is typed into a cell and is not translated.

data.name: Magic_SetBase_Param_Url
data.value: The base URL to prepend to relative request URLs.
data.comment: What the argument to #!http-set-base is.

data.name: Magic_SetBase_UrlRequired
data.comment: Shown when #!http-set-base is given nothing. Everything after 'Usage:' is typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_BothRequired
data.value: Both header name and value are required. Usage: #!http-set-header <name> <value>
data.comment: Shown when #!http-set-header is given too little. Everything after 'Usage:' is typed at a keyboard and stays as written.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_Description
data.value: Adds or updates a default HTTP header for all requests.
data.comment: What #!http-set-header does, shown in the list of magic commands.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_Done
data.comment: {0} is the header name and {1} its value, both as typed.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_Name
data.comment: Name of the #!http-set-header magic command as an extension, as listed in the Extensions panel. The command word itself is typed into a cell and is not translated.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_Param_Name
data.comment: What the first argument to #!http-set-header is.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_Param_Value
data.comment: What the second argument to #!http-set-header is.

data.name: Magic_SetHeader_ValueRequired
data.value: Header value cannot be empty. Usage: #!http-set-header <name> <value>
data.comment: Shown when the header was named but given no value.

data.name: Magic_SetTimeout_Description
data.value: Sets the default timeout (in seconds) for HTTP requests.
data.comment: What #!http-set-timeout does, shown in the list of magic commands.

data.name: Magic_SetTimeout_Done
data.comment: {0} is the number of seconds that was set.

data.name: Magic_SetTimeout_Invalid
data.value: A positive integer is required. Usage: #!http-set-timeout <seconds>
data.comment: Shown when #!http-set-timeout is given something that is not a whole number above zero.

data.name: Magic_SetTimeout_Name
data.comment: Name of the #!http-set-timeout magic command as an extension, as listed in the Extensions panel. The command word itself is typed into a cell and is not translated.

data.name: Magic_SetTimeout_Param_Seconds
data.comment: What the argument to #!http-set-timeout is.

data.name: Prefix_Error
data.comment: Written in front of a message a cell could not carry out. {0} is the message.

data.name: Renderer_Description
data.comment: What this renderer does, shown wherever extensions are listed.

data.name: Renderer_Name
data.comment: Name of the HTTP response renderer, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Response_Headers
data.comment: A heading the reader can open to see what the server sent back. {0} is how many there are.

data.name: Response_Truncated
data.comment: Shown under a body too long to show whole. {0} is the full size in kilobytes.

data.name: Run_Cancelled
data.comment: The reader stopped the cell before the answer came back.

data.name: Run_NoRequest
data.comment: The cell holds nothing that reads as a request.

data.name: Run_RelativeUrlNeedsBase
data.value: Relative URL '{0}' requires a base URL. Use #!http-set-base.
data.comment: The cell asks for a path with no address to hang it on. {0} is the path as written.

data.name: Run_RequestFailed
data.comment: The server answered, and said no. {0} is the status number and {1} the reason the server gave, which arrives in whatever language the server chose.

data.name: Run_Sending
data.comment: Printed before the request goes out. {0} is the method, such as GET, and {1} the address; both stay as written.

data.name: Run_TimedOut
data.comment: No answer came back in time. {0} is the number of seconds waited; the 's' after it is the unit and stays as written.
